requirements.notes: The executable Standard Loop portion is deliberately bounded to one generic Task with an explicit version-bound formal condition and a mandatory positive loopMaximum. testBefore selects pre-test or post-test evaluation. requirements.title: Protocol-bound Task outcomes and interrupting Boundary Error execution slice
requirements.notes: This atomic slice admits an immutable protocol-v3 binding on a generic Task, one-execution translation from a native managed-retry result, exact application-failure-to-BPMN-Error promotion, and at most one interrupting Boundary Error. The XML executable facade accepts task bindings explicitly through CompileXmlOptions and commits them to the executable fingerprint; bindings remain external executable inputs and are not inferred from BPMN XML. Schedule-to-close timeout remains operational and is not treated as a BPMN Error or Boundary Timer. This is not evidence for the complete Activity lifecycle, generic event propagation, BPMN Cancel, timers, non-interrupting boundaries, or event subprocesses.

requirements.title: Executable intersection of the named core-process XML profile and token kernel
requirements.notes: This is a deliberately narrower executable admission profile, not Process Execution Conformance. Profile bpmn-2.0.2-core-process-di-v3 admits while-style pre-test and BPMN post-tested Standard Loops only on a generic Task with an exact version-bound formal condition whose true result means continue and a mandatory positive loopMaximum. It rejects rather than infers unsupported process, gateway, event, activity, combined-loop, SubProcess-loop, multi-instance, and implicit-activation semantics.

source.section: tDefinitions, tProcess, tActivity, tStandardLoopCharacteristics, flow nodes, and tSequenceFlow

requirements.notes: Profile bpmn-2.0.2-core-process-di-v3 covers ordinary processes and recursive subprocesses, generic tasks, source-level callActivity callable-element QNames, none start/end events, exclusive/parallel gateways, sequence flows, conditions, defaults, definitions metadata, explicit expression-version bindings, and Standard Loop characteristics on generic Tasks. Its loop mapping requires one version-bound tFormalExpression loopCondition, materializes the BPMN testBefore=false default, and requires a positive loopMaximum. BPMN 2.0.2 permits loopMaximum to be absent and loopCondition to be absent or use the more permissive tExpression form; v3 rejects those broader forms instead of inventing executable behavior. Call activities are interchange-only until immutable child-target resolution and durable parent/child execution exist. This is a fail-closed implementation slice, not an OMG conformance subclass, complete semantic mapping, general Standard Loop profile, or multi-instance profile.

WCP21 Structured Loop - bounded generic Task subset
requirements.notes: This atomic requirement is scoped to executable while-style pre-test and BPMN post-tested behavior for one generic Task, with durable iteration identity, exact condition evidence whose true result means continue, and a mandatory positive iteration cap. It does not claim WCP21's combined pre/post-test variant, Standard Loops on SubProcesses, arbitrary cycles, or any multi-instance pattern. BPMN 2.0.2 section 13.3.6 explicitly maps Structured Loop to WCP-21; section 10.3.8 and Table 10.28 define the Standard Loop condition, testBefore default, and loopMaximum cap.
